raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be a retiree from"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Batar"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "receive after recalculation"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?amount
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?amount above "2000 lei"
